examples:
Example - Create a session space:
  agr session-space create --name customer-support --description 'Customer support sessions'

tags.usage: Resource tags as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin.

examples:
Example - Delete an empty session space:
  agr session-space delete --space-id space-a1b2c3d4

Example - Describe a session space:
  agr session-space get --space-id space-a1b2c3d4

Example - List session spaces:
  agr session-space list --limit 20

Example - Rename a session space:
  agr session-space update --space-id space-a1b2c3d4 --name customer-support-production

value.long: Create a session in a session space. Complex state and metadata fields accept inline JSON, @file, or - for stdin.
examples:
Example - Create a session with a stable ID:
  agr session create --space-id space-a1b2c3d4 --user-id user-123 --session-id session-123 --title 'Support request'

state.usage: Initial session state as a JSON object, @file, or - for stdin.

metadata.usage: Initial session metadata as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin.

examples:
Example - Delete a session:
  agr session delete --space-id space-a1b2c3d4 --user-id user-123 --session-id session-123

Example - Describe a session:
  agr session get --space-id space-a1b2c3d4 --user-id user-123 --session-id session-123

Example - List sessions in a session space:
  agr session list --space-id space-a1b2c3d4 --limit 20

user-ids.usage: User ID filter; repeat --user-ids for multiple values.

session-ids.usage: Session ID filter; repeat --session-ids for multiple values.

filters.usage: Session metadata filters as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin.
fields: Values: accepted values for the metadata key

value.long: Update a session title or replace its complete metadata array. Provide at least one of --title or --metadata.
examples:
Example - Update a session title:
  agr session update --space-id space-a1b2c3d4 --user-id user-123 --session-id session-123 --title 'Resolved request'

metadata.usage: Complete session metadata as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin. [] clears all metadata.

value.short: Append an event to a session (preview)
value.long: Append an event to a session. The event accepts inline JSON, @file, or - for stdin.
examples:
Example - Append a user event:
  agr session event append --space-id space-a1b2c3d4 --user-id user-123 --session-id session-123 --event '{"EventId":"event-123","Author":"user","Content":{"Role":"user","Parts":[{"Text":"Hello"}]}}'

event.usage: Event content as a JSON object, @file, or - for stdin.
fields: EventId: optional stable event ID for idempotent retries
Metadata: optional event metadata JSON string

examples:
Example - List recent session events:
  agr session event list --space-id space-a1b2c3d4 --user-id user-123 --session-id session-123 --limit 50
